content.text: Marvell has agreed to acquire Lumentum in a $115B all-stock deal, including debt. The AI angle is optical connectivity: moving data between accelerators matters as clusters scale. The merger still needs approvals, with closing expected in H1 2028. Which is the bigger AI bottleneck now: compute or networking?

visual.headline: MARVELL + LUMENTUM: $115B DEAL
visual.subheadline: All-stock acquisition agreement · Optical connectivity for AI data centers · Expected H1 2028 close, pending approvals
visual.alt_text: Original editorial information card about Marvell's November 2, 2026 agreement to acquire Lumentum in a $115 billion all-stock deal including debt. The companies focus on semiconductor and optical links for AI data centers. Closing is expected in the first half of 2028, subject to approvals.
